newsitem.title: BELGIUM: Belgian AvH ups stake in Sipef.
newsitem.headline: Belgian AvH ups stake in Sipef.

text.p: Belgian holding company Ackermans & van Haaren NV raised its stake in Belgian agricultural commodity group Sipef NV to 20.18 percent from 12.7, according to a bourse transparency statement published in Belgian newspapers on Tuesday.

"AvH became a shareholder at our request. There will be a written agreement that it will not increase its stake further," Belgian financial daily De Financieel-Economische Tijd quoted Sipef chief Theo Bracht as saying.

AvH now holds a direct 12.63 percent stake (up from 8.33 percent in February) and an indirect stake of 4.38 percent via BDS Holding NV. The remaining 3.17 percent is held by persons acting in concert with AvH.
The shares were bought both on and off the bourse.
Holding companies linked to Bracht together hold 10.9 percent of Sipef. Private Swiss bank Darier, Hentsch & Cie has 5.2 percent. Sipef's other shareholders are not known.
Sipef has plantations in countries such as Indonesia, Zaire, Ivory Coast, Liberia and Brasil. Products include palm oil, rubber, tea, coffee, cocoa, pineapple, banana and house plants.
